callback.description: The callback function to be invoked. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

error.description: The error to pass to the callback function. Can be 'null' if there is no error. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

value.description: The value to pass to the callback function. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.
